'''Semyon Alesker''' ({{langx|he|סמיון אלסקר}}; born 1972) is an Israeli [[mathematician]] at [[Tel Aviv University]]. For his contributions in [[convex geometry]] and [[integral geometry]], in particular his work on [[Valuation (geometry)|valuations]], he won the [[EMS Prize]] in 2000,<ref>{{cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=RBanCdPm0ZIC&q=Alesker%20EMS%20Prize&pg=PR23 |title=European Congress of Mathematics: Barcelona, July 10-14, 2000 |first=Carlos |last=Casacuberta |year=2001 |publisher=Birkhäuser |isbn=9783764364175 }}</ref> and the [[Erdős Prize]] in 2004.
